stories.title: Instacart reportedly discussed selling itself with DoorDash and Uber
stories.take: Instacart has reportedly talked about selling itself to DoorDash or Uber — a consolidation move that would reshape grocery delivery overnight.

stories.title: Block’s new voice model sounds eerily human
stories.take: Block's new voice model is eerily human and can run locally on an M4 Max MacBook — on-device voice AI is getting very good, very fast.

stories.title: The PHP Meltdown Shows How AI Makes Bugs More Exploitable

stories.take: Developers are already showing what Apple's first foldable is for — retro cassette players, virtual notebooks, even a digital toaster.

stories.title: Ray-Ban Meta Audio Review: The Best Smart Glasses
stories.take: Wired calls Meta's camera-free Ray-Ban Audio the best smart glasses yet — ditching the surveillance baggage makes them easy to actually live with.

stories.title: How Amazon Made a Stronger Partnership Play in Thursday Night Football in Year 5
stories.take: Amazon's Thursday Night Football partnership play is working in year 5: Prime Video advertisers are up 6% year over year.

stories.title: New Wildwood video reveals the painstaking beauty of Laika's handcrafted animation
stories.take: Laika's new Wildwood video is a love letter to handcrafted stop-motion — every detail made and moved by hand, and it shows.

stories.title: GameMaker will let indie developers sell their games for free from 2027
stories.take: GameMaker will let indie developers sell their games for free from 2027, dropping the Professional licence requirement across desktop, mobile, web and GX Games.

stories.title: Sources: Magic's Banchero out multiple weeks with ankle sprain
stories.take: Big blow for Orlando: Paolo Banchero has a low-grade high ankle sprain and will miss multiple weeks, per ESPN sources.

stories.take: LeBron will sit out against the Bucks in the first game of a back-to-back to manage low back pain/sciatica — his first missed game of the season.

stories.title: Mavs' Flagg out for home opener with mild left shoulder sprain
stories.take: Update on Cooper Flagg: the shoulder sprain from Aaron Nesmith's flagrant foul is mild, but he will miss the Mavs' home opener.

stories.title: Giannis continues blistering start with 36, confident winless Heat will click
stories.take: Giannis stays scorching — 36 points Friday, 71 through two games — and says the winless Heat will click despite their 0-2 start.

stories.title: NBA closing time: Amen Thompson erases Victor Wembanyama, Jayson Tatum daggers Knicks
stories.take: Friday's clutch reel: Amen Thompson erased Wembanyama at the rim to seal Houston's win, and Jayson Tatum daggered the Knicks late.

stories.title: What worked -- and what didn't -- in 12 NBA season debuts

stories.take: William Contreras is the Brewers' playoff MVP so far — driving in runs, throwing out runners, and keeping the pitching staff calm from behind the plate.

stories.title: The World Series of the have-nots is here. But baseball’s money problem isn’t going away | Tom Dart
stories.take: The have-nots' World Series is real — MLB's two best records on two of its smallest budgets — but the Guardian warns baseball's money problem isn't going away.

stories.title: Tailgates, watch parties and texts to Mom: Inside Milwaukee's joyous return to the World Series
stories.take: Milwaukee waited decades for this: tailgates, watch parties and texts to Mom as the Brewers' World Series return delivered in Game 1.

stories.title: Vogt shuns Mariners rumors, says he'll manage Guardians in '27

stories.title: Creating the ultimate 2026 World Series roster: Picking the best of the Brewers and Rays at each position
stories.take: Building the ultimate 2026 World Series roster: picking the best of the Brewers and Rays at every position.

stories.title: Hundreds of thousands march in France as protests take place across Europe – Europe live
stories.take: Hundreds of thousands marched in France as protests spread across Europe — 1,000 arrests in France, police raids in Milan, and marches in Spain and Albania.

stories.title: Nine killed and 40 injured after gunmen open fire at church funeral in Jordan
stories.take: Death toll rises in Jordan: nine killed and 40 injured when gunmen opened fire at a Greek Orthodox church funeral — authorities call it a terrorist attack on the Christian minority.

stories.title: Additional 178 cases of measles reported by US health authorities amid outbreak
stories.take: Measles keeps climbing: 178 new US cases this week bring the CDC tally to 4,588 across at least 43 outbreaks — more than double 2025.

stories.title: Vance front and center in Republican midterms push – is this a dry run for a White House bid?
stories.take: JD Vance is front and center in the Republican midterm push as Trump's popularity wanes — but inheriting the MAGA throne is messier than his visibility suggests.

stories.title: Republican billionaire Rick Jackson is walking a Trump tightrope in his quest to lead Georgia
stories.take: Billionaire healthcare magnate Rick Jackson, 72, is walking a Trump tightrope in his first campaign — a foster-home upbringing and a very different persona from the president's.

stories.title: Tens of thousands of Lula supporters rally on eve of Brazilian election runoff
stories.take: Eve of Brazil's runoff: tens of thousands of Lula supporters packed Rio's beach, with nearly 159 million voting Sunday and Lula tied with Flávio Bolsonaro after losing round one 47% to 45%.

stories.title: New York state woman charged with voting illegally says she recently learned she wasn't a citizen
stories.take: A New York woman charged with voting illegally says she only recently learned she wasn't a citizen — a case landing in the middle of the noncitizen-voting fight.

stories.title: 'This is not normal': Feds demand California counties set aside 'likely' noncitizen ballots
stories.take: 'This is not normal': federal prosecutors are demanding California counties set aside ballots from suspected noncitizens — at least 18 counties have letters, and LA County's case gets a federal hearing Tuesday.

stories.title: 9th Circuit blocks path for Trump to again deploy National Guard without state approval
stories.take: The 9th Circuit ruled Trump's California National Guard deployment last year unlawful and unconstitutional — and blocked a path to federalizing state troops over California's objection again.

stories.title: Sheriff Chad Bianco asks Riverside County to foot legal bills over ballot seizure
stories.take: Riverside Sheriff Chad Bianco, now a gubernatorial candidate, wants the county to foot his legal bills over his seizure of hundreds of thousands of special-election ballots.

stories.title: San Bernardino County owes $51 million to mother of mentally-ill man killed by deputies, jury says
stories.take: A federal jury says San Bernardino County owes more than $51 million to the mother of a mentally ill man killed by sheriff's deputies.

stories.title: LA chemical plant on short leash from state regulators as neighbors continue to protest its operations
stories.take: An LA hazardous-waste plant stays on a short leash: regulators sided with protesting neighbors on appeal over Phibro-Tech's long violation history — but won't revoke its permit.

stories.title: Hope and despair simmer among California Republicans ahead of election day
stories.take: Hope and despair in equal measure among California Republicans as election day nears — a party weighing what it can actually win in a deep-blue state.

stories.title: CA counties ordered to ID non-citizens, CalState faculty strike vote, Strange Pasadena — Saturday Edition
stories.take: Federal prosecutors told at least 18 California counties to set aside ballots from suspected non-citizens — legal experts question it under the 90-day purge rule, and LA County's hearing is Tuesday • Early voting opens statewide as the Cal State faculty union (29,000 members) starts a strike-authorization vote Monday over pay, AI protections and workload • Coastal flooding risk this weekend with tides up to 8 feet, plus a possible storm for Halloween weekend • Lighter tails: Pasadena's occult-haunted history and Tall Clubs International, the LA-born club for tall people now fighting a recruitment slump
